etsy_pack.description:
Illuminate your space with a touch of the macabre with this Gothic Ghost Face Candle Holder, perfect for horror enthusiasts and lovers of dark aesthetics.

This chilling design features an ivory, scream-inspired ghost mask emerging from flowing black hooded robes. The dramatic sculpted folds, shadowy black finish, and raised candle tray create a bold horror aesthetic that is both spooky and elegantly artistic.

This piece is 3D printed with attention to detail, resulting in a sturdy object with a detailed layer finish. It's a striking addition to any shelf, desk, or altar.

Each Gothic Ghost Face Candle Holder is made to order and 3D printed in Rockmart, Georgia.

Care instructions: Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Keep away from high heat sources to preserve its integrity.
